name: optcatalog_alloc_or_reuse_attach_node_child_clone
description: OptCatalog::AllocOrReuseAttachNodeChildClone reuses an entry-owned attach-child clone from the free list, or clones the attach template node when the free list is empty.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog runtime-instance source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4ae4b0 validates reading entry->attachCloneChildFreeList at offset 0xfc, popping the clone through callbackContext at node offset 0x40, clearing callbackContext before return, and falling back to CopyNodeWithCloneOptions(entry->attachCloneTemplateNode, 0, 1).
The native OptCatalog runtime free-list smoke verifies free-list reuse, callbackContext clearing, and clone fallback behavior through the parent allocation helper.
